summary: Ring Energy Inc. filed an 8-K Item 8.01 on May 12, 2026, disclosing entry into an underwriting agreement for a shelf takedown offering of 44,444,445 common shares with a 30-day greenshoe of 6,666,666 shares. The underwriters are Mizuho, BofA, and Raymond James. This is a routine underwritten public offering under an existing S-3 shelf, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event. It is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
